ms.report:
A. Output: Monthly personal CIP Editing reports for 3 months June - August 2025
Acceptance criteria: 
As previously defined in the milestone's Acceptance Criteria, reviewers can check these qualities of the posted work reports which detail the proposer's unique work supporting the CIP process:
・the report at each link is publicly readable, well-formatted, and clearly referring to the relevant month within the project term
・each report has a Quantitative section with general KPIs for group and individual activity
・each report has a Qualitative section with a paragraph for each key subjective accomplishment performed or initiated by the proposer
・each report has a Work on Pull Requests section (plus Issues / Discussions, if significant for that month) with detail about the work on standards issues which constitutes the bulk of project deliverables
・each item in the Work on Pull Requests section refers to a well-defined standards proposal, with its title and GitHub reference number (repeated in the links below it for one-click reference)
・each "pull request" item has a bulleted list of key actions taken by the proposer: each containing a summary of the action performed and/or why it was significant, plus a link for one-click verification of the date/time of the action and the authorship (generally the proposer), of detailed writing on GitHub to progress and summarise vital threads of CIP review
・each report concludes with a summary of each meeting held, confirming attendance & co-leadership of the meeting: with links to meeting agendas, key accomplishments summarised, and links to any official standards finally posted ("merged") after the meeting

Although neither the Catalyst proposal nor Statement of Milestones require any planned accomplishment for this period, the following unscheduled activities (spontaneous tasks and maintenance tasks) were noteworthy:
・(June 2025) Forming and recording original statements of "CIP Process" working group, with suggestions from dev
